post.title: 14 days in Japan in November — critique my plan
post.body: Day 1 land at Haneda, train to Shinjuku, check into hotel. Day 2 Meiji shrine then Harajuku, evening in Shibuya. Day 3 day trip to Nikko, back late. Day 4 teamLab then Odaiba. Day 5 shinkansen to Kyoto, Fushimi Inari early. Day 6 Arashiyama and the monkey park. Day 7 Nara day trip. Day 8 Osaka, castle and Umeda. We are open to restaurant recommendations anywhere along this route — we want to eat well and would love any ramen or okonomiyaki spots you rate. Day 9 Himeji. Day 10 back to Tokyo.
